flashcard_questions.q: A distinct area of the media industry that produces and distributes specific types of content, such as film, radio, or digital publishing.
Non-digital media channels that have existed for decades, including film, television, radio, and print publishing.
Digital media channels that have emerged more recently, including computer games, interactive media, the internet, and digital publishing.
Name the process where different media sectors merge together, such as a newspaper with both a print edition and a website.
Which new media sector covers eBooks, online magazines and podcasts?
